notes: Headroom uses at most 70% of the relevant frame interval; Tight uses up to 100%. Frame-generation grades apply to a native stream at the tested input size; resizing the fixture is outside timing. These are offline capacity hints, not an in-game FPS or latency guarantee.

MetalFX timings are GPU command intervals on a decoded NV12 video still, including color conversion. VideoToolbox timings are processor completion wall time over consecutive real video frames resized before timing where needed; its internal GPU time is not exposed.
